name: Algebraic Power Sums Disguise
description: Replaces the explicit pairwise distinctness condition with an equivalent system of power sum equations. By requiring the sum of the j-th powers of the selected parameters to equal the sum of the j-th powers of the integers 1 to k, it mathematically forces each parameter set to be a permutation of 1..k (via Newton's identities). This defeats models that rely on direct text matching for exact cover / 3-dimensional matching, as they fail to recognize the algebraic equivalence and cannot solve the equations directly.
